symptom: After `mxcli test --local` next to a running `run --local --watch`, javasource/system/UserActionsRegistrar.java still registered mxtest.actions.RegisterTestEndpoint although MxTest and its Java were removed; the dev loop's next warm build failed ('package mxtest.actions does not exist') and the app served a blank page (dist/index.js 404) until `run restart`. javasource/system/ is gitignored, so git status showed nothing.
cause: The test run's build regenerates the registrar with MxTest's action; cleanup removed javasource/mxtest but not the registrar line. A cold build regenerates the registrar; a warm --serve build does not.
fix: removeGeneratedJavaSource drops the registerUserAction(mxtest.…) lines from the registrar first, whether or not javasource/mxtest is still there.
insight: Cleanup that undoes the model change must also undo every file a build generated from it; a warm incremental build is the consumer that notices, because it does not regenerate what a cold build would. The first version scrubbed only after finding javasource/mxtest, and passed its unit test; live, the directory was already gone by then, so the scrub never ran. Only the live repro showed it: verify cleanup on the real sequence, not a fixture that has every file in place.
test: cmd/mxcli/testrunner/registrar_scrub_2639_test.go (the mxtest line goes, every other registration stays byte for byte); failed before the fix. Live 11.16.1 (the issue's script): before, line 15 left and the dev loop's next build failed; after, the registrar is clean.
